name: 400 sf Paver Patio
description: Everything for a 400 square foot paver patio on a compacted base: geotextile, high-performance base, bedding screenings, the paver field, edge restraint and polymeric jointing sand.

items.notes: HPB — 6" compacted base, allow for compaction
Paver field — order 5% over for cuts
Edge restraint on all open edges
Spikes — roughly one per foot of restraint
Polymeric sand — one bag per ~80 sf

name: 60 LF Segmental Retaining Wall (3' high)
description: A 60 linear foot segmental retaining wall at three feet exposed: levelling pad, wall units, drainage stone behind, fabric, and a finished cap course.

items.notes: Wall face — 60 lf x 3 ft exposed
Clearstone — 12" drainage zone behind the wall
Fabric between drainage stone and backfill

name: 800 sf Permeable Driveway
description: An 800 square foot permeable driveway in 80mm vehicular pavers over open-graded clearstone, with the deeper base a car requires.

items.notes: 80mm pavers — vehicular rated, do not substitute 60mm

name: Garden Beds & Mulch Refresh
description: A softscape refresh: bed edging, triple mix for planting, and a fresh mulch top-dress.
